name: agent_proposal_moodboard
_description: Fase D.3 (1/3) - Genera moodboard automatico para una propuesta. Lee design_option seleccionada + material_items aprobados + briefing. LLM construye paleta cromatica + lista de materiales agrupada + style rationale + image_prompt sugerido para mnml.ai. Ademas, si proposals.public_token IS NULL, genera uno (24 chars base64url) con expiracion 60 dias. Update proposals.moodboard_data + public_token.

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.project_id, p.title, p.scope_description, p.total_price, p.status, p.moodboard_data, p.public_token, pr.name AS project_name, pr.project_type, pr.property_area_m2, pr.location_city FROM proposals p JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = p.project_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, description, intervention_logic, rooms_layout FROM design_options WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND is_selected = true LIMIT 1

SELECT id, category, name, brand, model_ref, quality_tier, room_area, source_url FROM material_items WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status IN ('approved','ordered','suggested') ORDER BY category, quality_tier DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30
SELECT summary, client_needs, constraints FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_proposal_moodboard', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

UPDATE proposals SET moodboard_data = $2::jsonb, public_token = COALESCE(public_token, $3::text), public_token_expires_at = COALESCE(public_token_expires_at, $4::timestamptz), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, public_token, public_token_expires_at
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now(), output = $2::jsonb, metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb WHERE id = $1::uuid

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Start Execution').first().json.id, JSON.stringify({ proposal_id: $('Format Moodboard').first().json.proposal_id, public_token_generated: $('Format Moodboard').first().json.public_token_was_generated, palette_count: ($('Format Moodboard').first().json.moodboard.palette || []).length, materials_count: ($('Format Moodboard').first().json.moodboard.materials || []).length }), JSON.stringify({ model: $('Format Moodboard').first().json.model, tokens_in: $('Format Moodboard').first().json.tokens_in, tokens_out: $('Format Moodboard').first().json.tokens_out })] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { proposal_id: $json._proposal_id, project_id: $json._project_id, moodboard: $json._existing, public_token: $json._public_token, already_existed: true }, meta: { request_id: $json.request_id, source: 'cached' } }) }}
